recipes.name: Aloo Matar
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Toast the coriander and cumin seeds for 1 to 2 minutes. Stir throughout.
Then add the onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook for 3 minutes, stirring often.
Then add the salt, garam masala, turmeric, cayenne, and pepper. Toast for 30 - 60 seconds, stirring throughout.
Add the potatoes to the pot. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring frequently.

Pour in the tomatoes, water, and bouillon. Cover, bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer, cooking for 15 minutes. Then remove the lid and cook uncovered for another 15 minutes, or until the potatoes are cooked through.
Add the peas and coconut cream and let heat through.
Serve with rice or naan, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Coconut cream is the thick layer found on the top of a can of coconut milk. Placing the can of coconut milk in the fridge overnight can help the fat layer separate more easily, and yields more cream.
Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days.
